_om: Spionen in English (Spy, rusj.no/en/spy/): find the spy. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The places and roles are in data.en/steder.json and the question ideas in data.en/sporsmal.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Det der er ikke en spillkode. Koden har: That's not a game code. The code has {n} characters.
Koden har {n} tegn – du har skrevet {skr: The code has {n} characters – you've typed {skrevet}.
Koden stemmer ikke. Sjekk skrivefeil – o: That code doesn't match. Check for typos – and that everyone has reloaded the page.
Finn ut hvor dere er – uten at noen skjø: Work out where you all are – without anyone realising you don't know.
Dere er to spioner. Du vet ikke hvem den: There are two spies. You don't know who the other one is.
Ikke si stedet høyt!: Don't say the place out loud!
Ett av disse {n} stedene er stedet dere: One of these {n} places is where you are. Tap a place to cross it out.
Still dem til hvem som helst. Svar ærlig: Ask them to anyone. Answer honestly – but not so clearly that the spy works out the place.
{n} av {av} steder besøkt på denne mobil: {n} of {av} places visited on this phone.
Et sted får stempel når dere har spilt e: A place gets a stamp when you've played a round there.
Dere tok spionen – men spionen gjettet r: You caught the spy – but the spy guessed right: {sted}.
Spionen stoppet klokka selv og gjettet r: The spy stopped the clock and guessed right: {sted}.
Spionen ble tatt og gjettet feil: {sted}: The spy was caught and guessed wrong: {sted}.
Spionen stoppet klokka selv, men gjettet: The spy stopped the clock but guessed wrong: {sted}.
{navn} var uskyldig, så spionene slapp u: {navn} was innocent, so the spies got away.
{navn} var uskyldig, så spionen slapp un: {navn} was innocent, so the spy got away.
Dere ble ikke enige før tiden var ute, s: You didn't agree before time ran out, so the spies got away.
You didn't agree before time ran out, so the spy got away.
Ropte stopp og tok spionen {ganger}: Called stop and caught the spy {ganger}
Vi spilte {runder} av Spionen – og ingen: We played {runder} of Spy – and nobody scored.
Alle får vite hvor dere er – bortsett fr: Everyone knows where you are – except the spy. Ask sneaky questions, find the spy and don't let the spy guess the place.
Alle får samme sted og en rolle der. Spi: Everyone gets the same place and a role there. The spy just gets the message ‘You are the spy’.
Den som starter, spør en annen om stedet: The first player asks someone about the place. Whoever answers asks the next one. Not too obvious – the spy is listening!
Trykk «Stopp» og pek på den dere mistenk: Tap ‘Stop’ and point at your suspect. The spy can stop the clock at any time and guess the place.
Slipper spionen unna, eller gjetter sted: If the spy gets away, or guesses the place after being caught, the spy scores 2. If the spy stops the clock and guesses right, it's 3 – a bold spy!
Taper spionen, får alle andre 1 poeng. D: If the spy loses, everyone else scores 1. Whoever called stop and accused the spy gets 1 extra.
Blir spionen tatt, får spionen likevel e: If the spy is caught, they still get one go at guessing the place.
Står det likt til slutt, vinner den som: If it's a tie at the end, whoever won the most rounds as the spy wins.
De mulige stedene står under klokka hele: The possible places are under the clock all round – handy for the spy, and for bluffing.
Hver sin mobil: én lager en kode, de and: Own phones: one player makes a code, the others tap ‘Join a game’ and pick their number.
Svar gjerne i rollen din. Det er lov å o: Feel free to answer in character. Overacting is allowed! Three can play, but it's best with four or more.
Du er verten i dette spillet: You're the host of this game
Stedspasset: {n} av {av} steder besøkt: The place passport: {n} of {av} places visited
Alle ser kortet på sin egen mobil: Everyone sees their card on their own phone
Tre går fint – men spillet er best fra f: Three is fine – but it's best with four or more.
Navnene trengs bare på denne mobilen. De: The names are only needed on this phone. The others pick their number.
Skriv navn – eller spill som Spiller 1,: Type names – or play as Player 1, 2, 3 …
2 spies can be chosen from 7 players.
Med 2 spioner vet ingen av dem hvem den: With 2 spies, neither knows who the other one is.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se kortet: Hold your finger on the card to see {navn}'s card
Husket stedet og rollen? Trykk «Ferdig»: Got the place and the role? Tap ‘Done’ and pass the phone on.
Bare {navn} skal se. Slipp, så skjules k: Only {navn} should look. Let go and the card hides again.
Del koden med de andre: Share the code with the others
Skann QR-koden med kameraet: Scan the QR code with the camera
Eller åpne Spionen, trykk «Bli med i et: Or open Spy, tap ‘Join a game’ and type the code.
Nummeret står ved navnet ditt på neste s: Your number is next to your name on the next screen here.
QR-koden går rett til runde {n}. Skriver: The QR code goes straight to round {n}. Anyone typing the code taps ‘To round …’ until they reach round {n}.
De andre ser kortet sitt på sin egen mob: The others see their card on their own phone.
Finn navnet ditt. Nummeret ved navnet er: Find your name. The number next to it is what the others pick on their phones.
Alle trykker «Til runde {n}» på mobilen: Everyone taps ‘To round {n}’ on their phone and sees the new card.
Pek på den dere mistenker – eller gi der: Point at your suspect – or give yourselves one more minute.
You're at one of these {n} places.
Tell ned – og pek samtidig på den dere m: Count down – and all point at your suspect at once. Whoever gets the most fingers is accused.
Vi ble ikke enige – spionen slipper unna: We couldn't agree – the spy gets away
Spionen får én sjanse til. Gjetter {navn: The spy gets one more chance. If {navn} guesses the place, the spy still wins.
Riktig svar gir seier – feil svar gir ta: Right means victory – wrong means defeat.
Den som anklaget spionen, får 1 poeng ek: Whoever accused the spy gets 1 extra point.
Modig spion: 3 poeng for å stoppe klokka: Bold spy: 3 points for stopping the clock and guessing right.
1 point to everyone who wasn't the spy.
Dere avsluttet før første runde var ferd: You stopped before the first round was over.
Likt på poeng – flest runder vunnet som: Level on points – most rounds won as the spy decided it.
Skriv koden fra mobilen til den som star: Type the code from the phone of whoever started the game – or scan the QR code with your camera.
Se på mobilen til den som laget koden. N: Look at the phone of whoever made the code. Your number is next to your name.
Ett nummer per person. Nummeret låses nå: One number each. Your number locks once you've seen your card.
Nummeret er låst når du har sett kortet: Your number is locked once you've seen the card
Hvem vil se kortet sitt?: Who wants to see their card?
Only {navn} should look. Let go to hide it.
Da slipper spionene unna og får 2 poeng: Then the spies get away and score 2 points each.
Then the spy gets away and scores 2 points.
Then you stop the clock and guess the place. Right gives you 3 points. Wrong: the others win.
The spy only gets one go.
Runden dere er i, teller ikke. Dere går: The round you're in doesn't count. You'll go to the results with the points so far.
Dere går til kåringen med poengene så la: You'll go to the results with the points so far.
Trykk bare når den som laget koden har s: Only tap when whoever made the code has started a new round. Then you get a new card.
Du kan bli med igjen med den samme koden: You can join again with the same code.
